description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Empty` which represents a child element definition disallowing all child elements in an HTML Purifier context. It overrides validation to always return an empty array, indicating no children are allowed.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Empty
classes.description: Defines a child element pattern that disallows all children, extending the base class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the class instance.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and returns an array of allowed children; in this class, it always returns an empty array, disallowing all child elements.
